a set is a social group or circle

explanation.definitionFit: Elemi is a fragrant resin from tropical trees, used in varnishes and perfumes.

clue.text: A number with long hair will take part

clue.text: A large barrel is used in making port

taken as written

clue.text: Promptitude in installing audio equipment around bars

clue.text: No longer in accord over a charge, that's clear
